title: Grateful Dead Live at Oregon Country Fair on 1982-08-28
lineage: Cassette  (Nakamichi DR-1) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.03 -> FLAC/16

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard captures a festive, high‑energy show with a stellar West LA Fadeaway vocal and a powerful second set, though Brent’s lead on Far From Me falls flat.
ai_review.review: The recording is a clean soundboard mix that lets the band’s joyous playing shine through, highlighted by Jerry’s standout vocals on “West LA Fadeaway” and a punchy second‑set flow. Reviewers rave about the overall performance and classic Bobby moments, with only one song – Brent‑led “Far From Me” – drawing criticism.

ai_rating.rationale: Five detailed reviews give consistently high marks (average ~4.6). Show quality is praised as strong with standout moments, and the recording is described as clear soundboard capture, leading to a high combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, well‑balanced capture; reviewers describe the soundboard as crisp and fun with no noted audio issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Festive first set followed by a powerful, high‑energy second set that keeps the momentum rolling.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His vocal on West LA Fadeaway is praised as possibly his best ever recorded in the early ’80s.
band_member_comments.Bob: "Classic Bobby" comment indicates solid rhythm‑guitar and vocal contributions.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s lead vocals on Far From Me are criticized; some reviewers note mixed feelings about his early‑80s integration.
